title: Titanium Smartphone Mid-Frame
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is chosen for Titanium Smartphone Mid-Frame where scratch resistance (hardness 36 HRC) and premium tactile feel differentiate the user experience. Its thermal conductivity (6.7 W/mK) is 85% lower than aluminum, reducing heat transfer to the skin surface in handheld devices. The alpha-beta microstructure enables thin-wall CNC profiling to <0.5mm wall thickness while maintaining structural rigidity under 3-point bending — essential for Smartphone internal structural mid-frame chassis. This rationale is driven by smartphone internal structural mid-frame chassis and specific design requirements.
process: CNC milling HSM 30k RPM for phone hardware geometry
Tumble finish ceramic media with Class 6g gauge
PVD TiN/TiCN coating with Class 6g gauge
Optical Keyence inspection with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for smartphone internal structural application
commonFailures: Edge burr rejection Ra >0.8um - mitigated by ZrO2 ceramic bead tumble finish 45 minutes — critical for smartphone internal structural performance

faq.q: How does Titanium Smartphone Mid-Frame affect wireless signal transmission?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V has electrical conductivity of approximately 0.6 × 10⁶ S/m, significantly lower than aluminum (37 × 10⁶ S/m) or copper. For smartphone internal structural, this means reduced eddy current losses in antenna near-field regions. However, antenna design must account for the conductive housing — typically with >2 mm clearance or FPC antenna placement on the outer surface.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Smartphone Mid-Frame?
faq.a: Each Titanium Smartphone Mid-Frame shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for smartphone internal structural.
